images.name: 余烬·裂齿
images.design: Crimson staggered wedge-tooth mace. A stout elongated hexagonal barrel head, rounded only through six flat bevelled planes, with three OFFSET rows of thick short triangular wedge teeth staggered around its circumference. The teeth have broad rectangular roots and slanted chisel-like pyramidal points, not long needles. About nine striking teeth total, silhouette evokes a compact geometric crushing roller. Top a small flat hexagonal cap with a low central point. Central barrel remains substantial and readable between the teeth. No large square fortress cube, no stacked cubes, no torus. Straight hexagonal shaft, small angular hand stop and oblique clipped prism pommel. Scarlet core and coral-red luminous edges, a few tiny red wedge-shaped particles.

images.name: 流萤·棘笼
images.design: Jade/mint three-rib cage mace. A tall compact triangular-lantern head formed by THREE rigid straight angular ribs arranged 120 degrees apart around the shaft, meeting at thick triangular top and bottom collars. Each rib bends outward once into a substantial peaked elbow, with a short broad pyramidal tooth pointing out from that elbow. Large clean open slots between ribs expose a SHORT SOLID CENTRAL TRIANGULAR PRISM CORE connected at top and bottom. Absolutely no spiral, helix, twisting ribbons, spherical shell or botanical shapes. Thick angular load-bearing ribs, not flimsy wire. Top collar has one short triangular spike, triangular collar under head, stout straight shaft, split triangular hand stop and small hexagonal pommel. Deep jade planes with mint and turquoise edges, small diamond light motes.

images.name: 寒汐·砧阶
images.design: Cobalt/cyan stepped impact mace. A compact squat head built from FIVE thick horizontal octagonal slabs stacked along the shaft with tiny recessed seams; middle slab widest, upper and lower progressively narrower, producing a strong stepped diamond or barrel silhouette. On the widest three slabs, SHORT squared pyramid studs emerge from alternating sides, creating offset heavy geometric impact ledges. One connected solid head with clear horizontal layers, not a hollow ring, no central hole, no sharp circular saw discs, no thin plates, not a hammer with two separate striking faces. Head depth comparable to width, substantial weight and thickness. Low flat top cap, stepped shoulder to straight octagonal shaft, compact rectangular hand stop and squat tiered pommel. Blue core with icy cyan edges and small short rectangular blue particles.

images.name: 梦隙·星殛
images.design: Violet oblique star-core mace. A single compact solid RHOMBIC DODECAHEDRON head with broad diamond-shaped faces, tilted slightly relative to shaft. SIX stout broad-rooted geometric pyramidal studs grow from selected faces with unequal lengths, creating a clean asymmetric three-dimensional angular star silhouette. Thick faceted connected central volume remains clearly visible; maximum spike length one third core width, not an all-spike sea urchin. No cubes or stacked blocks, no ring, no hexagram symbol, no orbiting parts. The head attaches through a diagonal two-prong solid shoulder to a sturdy straight shaft; small asymmetrical chevron hand stop and faceted diamond pommel. Deep violet broad faces, lavender and blue-purple emissive ridges, a few tiny four-point diamond-shaped light motes. Strong readable compact mace silhouette.
